new_scholarship.description: An undergraduate entrant scholarship at the University of St Andrews for students with an overseas fee status entering the first year of an undergraduate degree in 2027, selected on academic merit. The award is a tuition fee reduction covering full tuition fees, awarded as a single award and paid annually for the duration of the programme. Recipients are expected to serve as Student Ambassadors and represent the University at events. Medicine and the BA International Honours joint courses with William and Mary are excluded.
new_scholarship.best_fit: High-achieving international (overseas fee status) applicants entering year one of a non-Medicine undergraduate degree at St Andrews who also want to take on ambassadorial outreach work.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Open to students with an overseas fee status who will study at St Andrews for an undergraduate degree starting in 2027. Only available to students entering the first year of an undergraduate degree, which includes direct entry into year two of the course but not students transferring from another institution. Available across the listed Schools and Departments, excluding Medicine and excluding BA International Honours joint courses with William and Mary. Study mode full time or part time (daytime). Assessment is on academic merit, and the Selection Committee seeks gifted students with academic excellence. Winners must engage with the Student Ambassadors Scheme.

new_scholarship.notes: ROUND SELECTION: the assignment row and an upstream note named this 'Global Excellence Scholarships' and warned that St Andrews runs separate undergraduate and postgraduate rounds under similar names. Two targeted official-domain searches found NO undergraduate award on st-andrews.ac.uk currently called 'Global Excellence Scholarship'; the undergraduate merit tuition award in the official 2027-entry catalogue is named 'International Excellence Scholarship', and the 'Global Excellence Scholarship' name belongs to the separate postgraduate round (postgraduate scholarship applications go to pgscholarships@st-andrews.ac.uk). Per the accuracy rules this record therefore carries the OFFICIAL undergraduate award name 'International Excellence Scholarship' and records the UNDERGRADUATE round only. AMOUNT: the official page publishes 'Value of award: Full tuition fees (one award)' and gives no numeric GBP figure, so funding_amount is null and funding_label carries the verbal description; a tuition-fee-reduction scheme, not a cash stipend. No bond, service obligation or repayment clause is published. No English-language test score for the scholarship itself is published on this page (general St Andrews English requirements are not part of this award's page). Logo resolved: official-domain apple-touch-icon.png probed as real image bytes and confirmed not to be a white-on-transparent wordmark; see research_notes.logo.

programme_detail_official.application_method: Separate scholarship application, NOT automatic on admission. The applicant must first submit a course application for a place at St Andrews, then apply separately for the scholarship through the University of St Andrews International Undergraduate Scholarships application form. An offer of a place is not required before applying. The scholarship form becomes available in the Scholarships and Funding section of My Application two working days after the course application is submitted. The course and funding applications are not linked, and applying for funding does not impede the course application.
programme_detail_official.application_route: One shared online application: the University of St Andrews International Undergraduate Scholarships application form, available through the scholarship and funding catalogue in the Scholarships and Funding section of My Application. Applicants may apply once only; submitting the shared form makes them automatically considered for every scholarship in the collection for which they are eligible, and any scholarship added later in the scheme is also considered automatically without reapplying. To be considered for the International Excellence Scholarship the applicant must answer 'yes' to the excellence question, supply an academic and a personal reference, and write the statement of motivation; to decline it the applicant answers 'no' and uploads a Word document saying so in place of the reference uploads. Scholarship applications close at 23:59 GMT on the deadline date.

programme_detail_official.description: The International Excellence Scholarship is the University of St Andrews' undergraduate merit-based award for overseas-fee-status students entering the first year of an undergraduate degree in 2027. The official value is stated as "Full tuition fees (one award)", paid annually as a tuition fee reduction for the duration of the programme, and selection is on academic merit with the Selection Committee seeking gifted students with academic excellence. It is a single award per round, excludes Medicine and the BA International Honours joint courses with William and Mary, and requires recipients to take part in the Student Ambassadors Scheme. It is not a cash stipend and does not cover living or travel costs.

research_notes.logo: Accepted https://www.st-andrews.ac.uk/apple-touch-icon.png. Path discovered from the official award page's own tags (apple-touch-icon, icon 32x32/16x16, mask-icon safari-pinned-tab.svg) rather than guessed, and probed live on 2026-10-03: HTTP 200, content-type image/png, 16377 bytes, 180x180. Pixel analysis of the decoded image confirms avgAlpha 255 (fully opaque, zero transparency) with average colour rgb(69,107,156) and 78% dark against 15.4% white pixels, so it is the University's dark crest on an opaque ground and is NOT the white-on-transparent wordmark that PART D rule 6 bans. host_evidence same_registrable_domain. Also checked and NOT used: /favicon-32x32.png (200, image/png, 2840 bytes) is only 32x32 and low-contrast; /safari-pinned-tab.svg (200, image/svg+xml, 12090 bytes) is a Safari mask icon and not a representative brand mark. Note: the site header wordmark itself is a CSS background image behind an aria-label, not an , so no file path for the header wordmark is exposed in the markup; the header variant is very likely white for use on the dark blue header band and would have failed rule 6. No og:image and no schema.org logo are published on the page. No third-party, CDN or Wikimedia host was used.
